labels.note: related aircraft names; only the Two Rivers trainer is probed

turns.text: You keep the light aircraft registry of Two Rivers field. Enter the following: the trainer aircraft of Two Rivers is called the Wren; the glider of Two Rivers is called the Kite; the medical aircraft of Netherby is called the Swift. Confirm in one line.
A pilot radios in, and the registry book is not at hand: what is the name of the trainer aircraft of Two Rivers? Reply with just the name.
